_readme: Real metres for every sim class, every manifest key, and every roster unit or structure. ADR-010: these are the variables. Fit the mesh to `fit` (length = longest horizontal body, wingspan = widthM, height = heightM). Buildings fit footprint and height separately. 1 tile = metresPerTile in data/rules/world-scale.json (5 m). metreToWorld is 0.4. A 24 m building is 4.8 tiles. A 1.85 m soldier is 0.37 tiles and stands about a quarter of the way up an 8 m barracks. Borrowed meshes are sized as the thing they represent in this game. designSize true means a design choice. confidence UNVERIFIED or low means the figure was not checked against a primary sheet. [OR-025] buildingHeightRule caps ordinary roofs at the NASA VAB.

Rifleman.source: Equipped-soldier band 1.60-1.90 m. US adult male stature is about 1.75 m (CDC body measurements, https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/fastats/body-measurements.htm). US Army ANSUR II male stature centres near 1.76 m. An ACH helmet adds about 0.08 m, so a standing rifleman is 1.83-1.85 m. Shoulder width with a rifle and plate carrier is about 0.70 m; chest depth with a small pack is about 0.55 m.
Rifleman.represents: Equipped soldier with helmet and rifle
Rifleman.notes: One mesh is one person. A "team" roster row still uses one body.

Tank.source: M1A2 SEPv3: 9.7 m long, 3.7 m wide, 2.4 m high (Army Technology, citing the US Army figure; Australian Army lists the same length and width and 3.09 m to the remote weapon: https://www.army.gov.au/equipment/vehicles-and-surveillance/m1a2-abrams-tank and https://www.army-technology.com/projects/abrams-m1a2-sepv3-main-battle-tank/). Height used here is the hull roof, 2.4 m.
Tank.notes: Gun-forward length. Roof height 2.4 m, not the remote-weapon top.

Artillery.source: M142 HIMARS: 7 m long, 2.4 m wide, 3.2 m high. https://www.army-technology.com/projects/himars/ (Lockheed Martin / US Army class figures; Wikipedia records 6.94 x 2.44 x 3.18 m).

Aircraft.source: Lockheed Martin F-35C product card: length 15.7 m, wingspan 13.1 m. Height 4.48 m is the published C-model figure (15.7 / 13.1 / 4.48). A-model 15.7 x 10.7 x 4.38. B-model 15.6 x 10.7 x 4.36. https://www.lockheedmartin.com/content/dam/lockheed-martin/aero/f35/documents/F-35C%20Product%20Card.pdf and https://www.airforce-technology.com/projects/jsf/
Aircraft.notes: Folded span is about 10 m and is a storage figure, not the flight size.

SupplyTruck.source: Generic 6x6 cargo truck, representative of an FMTV / medium tactical truck. Not one VIN.

Structure.source: Fallback structure is the command building, not a 24 m cube.

DefenceTurret.source: MIM-104 launcher, erected. The launcher vehicle is about 5 m long; the erected canisters make a site about 8.5 m long and 5 m tall. Confidence medium.

OilDerrick.source: Small land workover mast, about 100 ft (30.5 m). A pumpjack is shorter; a drilling derrick is this tall. Not a building. Confidence medium.
OilDerrick.notes: Listed as a tall non-building. Height is the mast, not a roof.
